# Hasanuddin University Journal Platform

> An open-access academic publishing platform hosting peer-reviewed journals across social sciences, forestry, political studies, and peace research from Hasanuddin University.

Hasanuddin University's journal platform provides open-access publication venues for Indonesian and international researchers. The platform operates under Creative Commons licensing and hosts multiple disciplinary journals including peace studies, glocal society research, forestry science, and political insights.

## Key Topics

- Open Access Publishing
- Academic Journals
- Hasanuddin University
- Social Sciences
- Peace and Security Studies
- Democracy Research
- Glocal Studies
- Forestry Research
- Political Insights
- Indonesian Research
- Creative Commons Licensing
- OJS 3 Platform
- Peer Review
- Current Issues
- Submission Guidelines

## Featured Journals

- [Glocal Society Journal](https://journal.unhas.ac.id/index.php/gs): Homepage for Glocal Society Journal at Hasanuddin University, publishing research on local-global interconnections
- [Binanga](https://journal.unhas.ac.id/index.php/binanga): Homepage for Binanga forestry journal by Hasanuddin University's Faculty of Forestry
- [Hasanuddin Journal of Political Insights](https://journal.unhas.ac.id/index.php/hjpi): Homepage for Hasanuddin Journal of Political Insights, featuring political research and analysis
- [Journal of Peace, Security and Democracy](https://journal.unhas.ac.id/index.php/jpsd/issue/current): Journal of Peace, Security and Democracy published by the Center for Peace, Conflict and Democracy (CPCD)

## Current Issues

- [Glocal Society Journal Vol. 2 No. 1 (2025)](https://journal.unhas.ac.id/index.php/gs/issue/current): Current issue of Glocal Society Journal, Vol. 2 No. 1 (2025)
- [Journal of Peace, Security and Democracy Vol. 2 No. 1 (2026)](https://journal.unhas.ac.id/index.php/jpsd/issue/current): Current issue of Journal of Peace, Security and Democracy by CPCD
- [Binanga Current Issue](https://journal.unhas.ac.id/index.php/binanga/issue/current): Current issue archive for Binanga forestry research journal
